purpose: Teach: 縮減/教示/貸し付け/取り付ける/通帳/差し止め/持ち株/引き下げる

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、無駄を縮減する精神を貫かれたぞ
lines.en: When you founded the company, you held true to the principle of eliminating waste.
lines.style: Measured, reflective cadence. Slight weight on each memory—not rushing. Voice carries respect earned over decades. Quiet certainty, as if reviewing principles that guided a lifetime.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に経営の心得を教示された
lines.en: Yes. You taught the staff the fundamentals of running a business.
lines.style: Steady, affirmative. Brief pause before speaking—gathering the memory. Voice level, neither defensive nor proud. The tone of someone confirming what was already understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お取引先に貸し付けで支援されたぞ
lines.en: You supported our business partners by extending loans to them.
lines.style: Gentle, almost tender. Voice slightly distant—gazing back. Soft weight on the word 'supported.' The tone of someone remembering an act of quiet generosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社屋に手すりを取り付ける配慮もされた
lines.en: Yes. You even had handrails installed in the building—thinking of the people who worked there.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Slight warmth enters the voice here—noticing the small kindness. Not dramatic. Just acknowledging that care lived in the details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、通帳を自ら管理されたぞ
lines.en: You managed the account books yourself—never delegated that responsibility.
lines.style: Voice carries admiration tinged with distance. Paced slowly, as if turning over the weight of that commitment. Trailing slightly on the image of personal accountability.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはコピー商品の差し止め訴訟を起こされた
lines.en: Yes. You took legal action to stop counterfeit products—protected what you'd built.
lines.style: Firm but not hard. Voice settles on 'took legal action' with quiet resolve. Not boastful—simply stating that protecting principles mattered enough to fight for.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、持ち株戦略を巧みに組まれたぞ
lines.en: You crafted your shareholding strategy with remarkable skill.
lines.style: Admiration clear in the voice now. Slight upward inflection on 'skill'—genuine appreciation for the acumen. Paced with deliberation, as if reviewing a masterwork.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員給与を絶対に引き下げる事はなかった
lines.en: Yes. Through all of it, you never once cut the staff's salaries.
lines.style: Voice grows quieter, more grounded. Weight on 'never'—that word carries the whole philosophy. Closing with finality and deep respect. The voice of someone who understands what that choice meant.
